title: The Knave and the Moon
author: Rachel Gillig
note: Trapped as the king's bride and grieving a cathedral turned to ruin, Sybil Delling finds an unlikely hope when a fighter with no name and no memory enters the royal tournaments — one who may be her only way out. Rachel Gillig's gothic sequel to The Knight and the Moth is a tale of faith, sacrifice, and redemption in a kingdom built on secrets.
